description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget called PaymentMethodSheet, which provides a bottom sheet UI for selecting among different payment methods such as Paytm, Google Pay, PhonePe, and Cash. It includes methods for building the UI, handling user interactions, and launching external payment apps via deep links.

classes.name: PaymentMethodSheet
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that renders a bottom sheet UI for selecting and launching different payment methods.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the payment method sheet, including options for Paytm, Google Pay, PhonePe, and Cash.

methods.name: _buildPaymentOption
methods.description: Helper method to create a list tile for each payment option with associated icon, color, and tap handler.

methods.name: _launchPaymentApp
methods.description: Attempts to launch an external payment app using the provided deep link URI; shows a snackbar if the app is not installed.
